import sys
import subprocess

def install_and_import(package, import_name=None):
    if import_name is None:
        import_name = package
    try:
        __import__(import_name)
    except ImportError:
        print(f"Installing {package}...")
        try:
            subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", package])
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to install {package} via pip: {e}")

install_and_import("torch")
install_and_import("pandas")
install_and_import("transformers")

import os
import urllib.request
import pandas as pd
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForMultipleChoice
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rowanz/swagafact/master/data/val.csv"
val_file = "val.csv"
if not os.path.exists(val_file):
    print("Downloading SWAG validation set...")
    try:
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, val_file)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to download validation set from primary URL: {e}")
        backup_url = "https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/rowanz/swagafact/master/data/val.csv"
        print("Trying backup URL...")
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(backup_url, val_file)

df = pd.read_csv(val_file)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

if device.type == "cpu":
    print("CPU detected. Evaluating on 500 examples to ensure fast execution.")
    df = df.head(500)
else:
    print("GPU detected. Evaluating on full validation set.")

model_names = [
    "ehdwns1516/bert-large-uncased-SWAG",
    "Rohan/bert-large-uncased-swag",
    "yjernite/bert_large_uncased_swag",
    "aa37/bert-large-uncased-swag"
]

model = None
tokenizer = None
for model_name in model_names:
    try:
        print(f"Trying to load model: {model_name}")
        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
        model = AutoModelForMultipleChoice.from_pretrained(model_name)
        print(f"Successfully loaded {model_name}")
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to load {model_name}: {e}")

if model is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not load any fine-tuned SWAG model.")

model.to(device)
model.eval()

input_ids_all = []
attention_mask_all = []
labels_all = []

print("Tokenizing dataset...")
for i in range(len(df)):
    first_sentence = str(df.iloc[i]["sent1"])
    question_header = str(df.iloc[i]["sent2"])
    choices = [str(df.iloc[i][f"ending{j}"]) for j in range(4)]
    
    first_sent_list = [first_sentence] * 4
    second_sent_list = [f"{question_header} {choice}" for choice in choices]
    
    inputs = tokenizer(
        first_sent_list,
        second_sent_list,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        max_length=80,
        return_tensors="pt"
    )
    input_ids_all.append(inputs["input_ids"].unsqueeze(0))
    attention_mask_all.append(inputs["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(0))
    labels_all.append(int(df.iloc[i]["label"]))

input_ids_all = torch.cat(input_ids_all, dim=0)
attention_mask_all = torch.cat(attention_mask_all, dim=0)
labels_all = torch.tensor(labels_all)

dataset = TensorDataset(input_ids_all, attention_mask_all, labels_all)
dataloader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=8 if device.type == "cpu" else 32, shuffle=False)

correct = 0
